runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text: M-25-22 takes effect for new AI contracts 180 days after it was issued. It covers any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance, and any option to renew or extend performance exercised on an existing contract after that date. The memo does not cover AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
